versions.changelog:
Major upgrade: Automated generation of MCP servers, API clients, and webhook handlers from OpenAPI/Swagger specs.

- Generates ready-to-use MCP server code, Python API clients, and secure webhook handlers.
- Handles authentication (API key, OAuth2, Bearer token), rate limiting, and retries out-of-the-box.
- Works from both existing OpenAPI/Swagger specs or minimal specs created from API docs.
- Clear guidance for users on when and how to activate or use the skill.
- Designed for fast, robust scaffolding of REST API integrations.
